1479-3478-8293.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Cleveland Booker, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

5170-6132-7286-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

116-512-527.easyPrerequisites: Selvala and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-512-527.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
116-512-527.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
116-512-527.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Selvala's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

1339-5789-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-5789-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5254-8122.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
4050-5254-8122.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
4050-5254-8122.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

1479-2841-3678-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3678-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Retreat to Emeria and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

5166-7167--86.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Wrathful Raptors to take damage.
5166-7167--86.description:
Cause Wrathful Raptors to take damage by any method.
Wrathful Raptors triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Wrathful Raptors.
Repeat from step 2.

2738-4871-6797-6887.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, The Skullspore Nexus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-4050-5662--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

713-2438--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Surrak and Goreclaw triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

206-2457-4094-4289.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-3499-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

480-3967-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.

2510-4046-7070.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-4046-7070.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Outrider en-Kor.
The Outrider en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Outrider en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

4316-5078-6259.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

813-5733-5895.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
813-5733-5895.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its prowl cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng and Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

3875-5412-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3875-5412-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Tireless Provisioner trigger that many times.
Resolve all Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens, and then an additional Clue or Treasure token for each remaining trigger.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1329-1778-2178-4050.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-4050.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding one mana of any color.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

1251-2457-3129-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1251-5470-6188.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
1251-5470-6188.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

647-3372-4050-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
647-3372-4050-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {1}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

225-2681-5881-5885.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, plus an additional {2}{G} if you don't control a commander
225-2681-5881-5885.notablePrerequisites: Anzrag and Stone-Seeder Hierophant do not have summoning sickness.
225-2681-5881-5885.description:
Activate Anzrag by paying {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, causing opponents to block Anzrag if able this turn.
Cast Obscuring Haze by paying {0} if you control a commander, or {2}{G} otherwise, preventing all combat damage that would be dealt by opposing creatures this turn.
Declare Anzrag as an attacker, attacking any opponent.
If the opponent does not control a creature, activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, it triggers, causing the defending opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
The opponent is forced to block Anzrag, triggering Anzrag, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Any combat damage that would be dealt to Anzrag is prevented by Obscuring Haze.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2281-4050-4871-5006.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Saffi dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Lurrus, adding {G}.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

719-1821-2837.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
"Phyrexian" chosen with Xenograft.
719-1821-2837.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
When the creature entes the battlefield as a Phyrexian due to Xenograft, Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste or a 3/1 Dog creature token with vigilance.
Repeat step 2.

1636-4410-5251.notablePrerequisites:
Hermetic Study attached to Emmara.
Emmara does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4410-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, targeting any player or planeswalker.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Emmara ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any player or planeswalker.
Repeat.

1170-1414-4211-5089.notablePrerequisites: At least three loyalty counters on Karn.
1170-1414-4211-5089.description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Activate Karn's -2 ability, putting Lotus Petal into your hand from exile.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Karn.
Lotus Petal resolves.
Activate Karn's -2 ability, putting Tormod's Crypt into your hand from exile.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Karn.
Tormod's Crypt resolves.
Repeat.

1558-3529-4231-4284.notablePrerequisites:
Clone is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-3529-4231-4284.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

730-1479-5233.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
730-1479-5233.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Emeria Angel, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Emeria Angel trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1645-3809.description:
Cast Crown of Flames for {R}, targeting Goldspan Dragon.
Goldspan Dragon triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Crown of Flames for {R}, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.

2939-3966.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2939-3966.description:
Gain life.
Defiant Bloodlord triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
